# The Ritz-Carlton

> > The Ritz-Carlton is a global luxury hotel and resort brand offering world-class accommodations, exceptional service, and curated travel experiences across iconic destinations worldwide.

The Ritz-Carlton operates luxury hotels and resorts in premier locations around the world, including beachfront properties, urban hotels, and exclusive Reserve properties. Part of Marriott International, the brand offers Marriott Bonvoy rewards, family programs like Ritz Kids, and comprehensive wellness and dining experiences that define modern luxury hospitality.

- [Sharq Village & Spa, a Ritz-Carlton Hotel | Luxury Beach Hotel in Doha](https://www.ritzcarlton.com/en/hotels/dohsq-sharq-village-and-spa-a-ritz-carlton-hotel/overview/): Sharq Village & Spa beachfront resort in Doha with Qatari heritage design
- [The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai | 5-Star Hotel in Jumeirah Beach, Dubai](https://www.ritzcarlton.com/en/hotels/dxbrz-the-ritz-carlton-dubai/overview/): 5-star oceanfront hotel on Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina District
